game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the druid must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Filter Harvest: Combine for and if to harvest only vine ropes that meet a rule.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Combine for and if to harvest only vine ropes that meet a rule. Each round, giant beetles strike the heartwood tree, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the harvest value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the heartwood tree from giant beetles in Mossy Creek: keep the harvest meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 80-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: harvest drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 80-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Filter Harvest
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Filter Harvest' (Week 5 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mossy Creek'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how harvest changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mossy Creek.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 80 seconds while harvest > 0.
